PART I—Orders and Notifications by the Governor of West Bengal, the High Court, Government Treasury, etc.
WEST BENGAL STATE ELECTION COMMISSION
18, Sarojini Naidu Sarani (Rawdon Street)
Kolkata - 700 017
No. 3074-SEC/1D-239/2022 Dated, Kolkata, the 25th Day of November, 2022
ORDER
In exercise of the power conferred by Section 140 of the West Bengal Panchayat Act, 1973 read with Sections 16
& 17 of the West Bengal Panchayat Elections Act, 2003 read with Rules 26 & 27 of the West Bengal Panchayat Elections
Rules, 2006 the West Bengal State Election Commission hereby determines and publishes, after previous publication of
the Draft of this Order, the Final Order for Delimitation of Alipurduar Zilla Parishad Constituencies and Reservation of
Seats thereto for Panchayat General Elections, 2023 as required under the said Rules. The Block(s) have been specified
in column (1) of the Schedule below (hereinafter referred to as the said Schedule), the number of members to be elected
to the Zilla Parishad has been specified in the corresponding entries in column (2), the area of the Block has been divided
into constituencies as specified in the corresponding entries in column (3), the constituency or constituencies reserved
for the Scheduled Tribes (ST), the Scheduled Castes (SC) or the Backward Classes (BC) have been determined as
specified in the corresponding entries in column (4) and the constituency or constituencies reserved for Women (W)
have been determined as specified in the corresponding entries in column (5) of the said Schedule.

ORDER

In exercise of the power conferred by sections 14 and 17 of the West Bengal Panchayat Elections Act, 2003
(West Ben. Act XXI of 2003), read with rules 24 and 25 oft he West Bengal Panchayat Election Rules, 2006, I, the
District Panchayat Election Officer and District Magistrate of the District of Cooch Behar, as the prescribed authority
apponted by the State Goverment in the Department of Panchayats and Rural Development under notification No.
623-PN O1 3R-3/2004 dated, Kolkata, the 9th February, 2007 for the purpose of rules 24 & 25 of the said rules, here
by determine after previous publication of the Draft of this order as required under the said rules, for the Grams
specified in column (1) of the Schedule below the number of members to be elected to the Panchayat Samiti
specificd in the corresponding entries in column (2), to divide the area of the Grams into constituencies with serial
numbers assigned to them specified in the corresponding entries in column (3) & (4), constituency or constituencies
Teserved for the Scheduled Castes or the Scheduled Tribes or the Backward classes persons specified in the
comesponding entries in column (5), & constituency or constituencies reserved for women specified in the

Order
No PRD/ 1153 Dated : 15/11/2017
In exercise of the power conferred by section 12 and 17 of the West Bengal Panchayat Election Act, 2003 (West Ben. Act XXI of 2003), read with rules 22 and 23 of
the West Bengal Panchayat Election Rules, 2006, I, the District Panchayat Election Officer and District Magistrate of the District of Cooch Behar, as the prescribed
authority appointed by the State Government in the Department of Panchayats and Rural Development under notification No. 623-PN/O/I/3R-3/2004, dated Kolkata,
the 9th February, 2007 for the purpose of rules 22 and 23 of the said rules, hereby publish the draft of this order to determine for the Grams specified in column (1) of
the schedule below, the total number of members, Schedule Caste members, Schedule Tribes members, Backward Classes members and women members to be elected
to such Gram Panchayats specified in the corresponding entries in columns (2a), (2b), (2c), (2d) and (2e) respectively, to divide the area of the Grams into
constituencies with serial number assigned to them specified in the corresponding entries in column no. (3), to allocate to each such constituency seat or seats specified
in the corresponding entries in column (4), seat or seats
reserved for the Scheduled Castes or the Schedule Tribes or Backward Classes persons specified in the corresponding entries in column (5), and seat or seats reserved
for women specified in the corresponding entries in column (6) of the schedule, for information of persons likely to be affected thereby.
The draft will be taken up for consideration after fifteen days from this day and any objection or suggestion with respect thereto, which may be received by the
undersigned within the said period, shall be duly considered.
